title: Faster wizard casting
changes: Wizard spells come back much faster (most attack spells in 1 to 2.5 seconds) and cost less mana; each cast hits a bit softer to make up for it.
Meteor Shower, Blizzard and Thunderstorm go off at once, with no charge-up.
Hold a skill key, the right mouse button or Space to keep casting toward the mouse: the next cast goes off the moment it is ready.
